keyEntry.title: GitHub Copilot API key
keyEntry.optional: This is entirely optional. If you decline, nothing changes; everything else on the row stays the same.
keyEntry.what: If you provide a key, the app makes a single request: it reads this month’s Copilot AI credits from api.github.com. It requests no other address; resolving that name uses your Windows DNS settings.
keyEntry.frequency: That request is made at most once every 15 minutes.
keyEntry.proxy: Usage Notch does not use a system proxy, so on a network that requires one this request cannot complete and the credit figure stays unavailable. Everything else on the row is read from local files.
keyEntry.kept: Only numbers are kept from the reply: this month’s credit counts and the time of the reading.
keyEntry.storage: The key is stored on this computer, encrypted for this Windows user. That protects it from other user accounts and from the file being copied elsewhere; it does not protect it from programs running as this user.
keyEntry.selfPaid: It works only for Copilot plans you pay for yourself; for plans paid by an organisation these numbers are not returned.
keyEntry.removeNote: “Remove key” deletes only the copy on this computer. You also need to revoke the key at GitHub.
keyEntry.leastPrivilege: Least-privilege key: on GitHub, create a fine-grained personal access token, grant only User → Plan: read, and pick a short expiry.
keyEntry.pasteWhenBack: This page stays open and keeps what you typed; when you come back you can paste the key below.
keyEntry.usernameHint: Letters, digits and hyphens only; 39 characters at most.
keyEntry.keyHint: What you type is never shown on any screen and never written to logs.
keyEntry.error.empty: The username and the key are both required.
keyEntry.error.usernameShape: A username can contain only letters, digits and hyphens, and at most 39 characters.
keyEntry.error.wrongTokenType: This looks like a different kind of GitHub token. Please create a fine-grained personal access token.
keyEntry.error.wrongProvider: This key is not for this tool.
keyEntry.error.secureStorage: Windows encrypted storage is unavailable, so the key was not saved.
keyEntry.error.busy: Another operation is in progress; try again in a few seconds.
keyEntry.error.unknown: The key could not be saved.
keyEntry.error.invalidUsername: That username is not valid. Use only letters, digits and hyphens, and at most 39 characters.
keyEntry.error.storeFailed: The key could not be saved on this computer.
keyEntry.error.noEntry: This window's session was not found. Close it and open it again.
keyEntry.error.expired: The window timed out. Open it again and try once more.
keyEntry.error.rejected: The request was not accepted. Close the window and open it again.
